additionalActions.title: Expose the detection webhook to browsers
additionalActions.text: Marketplace starts the webhook sidecar (default port 3080). The plugin UI needs a URL the browser can reach.
instructions: Marketplace starts the server/ webhook sidecar in Docker. You do not need to run npm start yourself.
In the plugin UI, set the backend URL to an address the browser can open (not only localhost on the CloudTAK host).
If users open CloudTAK remotely, reverse-proxy a path to the sidecar and use that HTTPS URL in the plugin.
Paste the snippet below into the Caddy site block that already reverse-proxies cloudtak-api, then reload Caddy.

additionalActions.title: Route /print-api through Caddy
additionalActions.text: The print Docker service is started by Marketplace. Browsers still need Caddy (or equivalent) to reach /print-api. Deploy To Caddy joins a Docker Caddy container to CloudTAK's network so reverse_proxy cloudtak-print works; for host/systemd Caddy it publishes 127.0.0.1:5010 and points the snippet at loopback instead. An existing (cloudtak_print) block is left alone.
instructions: Marketplace starts the print Docker service. Do not paste the compose block by hand.

Use Deploy To Caddy when available — it pastes the snippet, reloads Caddy, and (for Docker Caddy) connects Caddy to whichever Docker network CloudTAK is already on. For host/systemd Caddy it uses reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:5010.
Or paste the snippet below at the TOP LEVEL of your Caddyfile, outside every site block. On host Caddy, change cloudtak-print:5010 to 127.0.0.1:5010.
Inside the site block that already has reverse_proxy cloudtak-api:5000, add: import cloudtak_print
Reload Caddy: docker compose exec caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile (or systemctl reload caddy on the host).
Check both https://YOURHOST/print-api/health and https://YOURHOST/print-api. The second must return application/json, not HTML.

additionalActions.title: Optional: transparent print margins
additionalActions.text: Add GDAL_PDF_BANDS=4 to the CloudTAK events service environment so printed sheet margins stay transparent when imported back onto the map.
instructions: In the CloudTAK events service environment, add: GDAL_PDF_BANDS=4
Recreate the events container after saving compose.

additionalActions.title: Route /skydio-relay through Caddy
additionalActions.text: Marketplace starts the telemetry relay sidecar (default port 8081). Browsers still need Caddy (or equivalent) to reach /skydio-relay so large-flight telemetry can bypass the Plugin Proxy ~1MB limit.
instructions: Marketplace starts relay-server/ in Docker as cloudtak-plugin-skydio-sidecar. You do not need to run npm start yourself.
Use Deploy To Caddy when available — it pastes the snippet, reloads Caddy, and (for Docker Caddy) connects Caddy to CloudTAK's network. For host/systemd Caddy it uses reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8081.
In the Skydio plugin Settings, set Skydio Telemetry Relay URL to https://YOURHOST/skydio-relay/skydio (same origin as CloudTAK).
Also enable CloudTAK Admin → Plugin Proxy and whitelist https://api.skydio.com plus any Authentik/webhook hosts you configure in Settings.

additionalActions.title: Optional: real-time alerts via webhook SSE
additionalActions.text: SSE alerts need an external webhook server and Authentik OAuth (not started by Marketplace). Without them the plugin can poll Skydio with the API key only.
instructions: Deploy a webhook server that accepts Skydio POSTs and exposes GET /events/skydio with CORS for your CloudTAK origin.
In Settings → Webhook SSE, enter Authentik client ID/secret, token URL, SSE URL, and webhook URL; register that webhook with Skydio.
